news.Title: Forget Broadcom: Nvidia (NVDA) Is Still the Top Semiconductor Stock for 2027 and Beyond
news.Content:
When someone asks me to name the best semiconductor stock to buy for now and the next few years, my answer is Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA). I look at plenty of other chip names, including Broadcom and Advanced Micro Devices , yet I keep coming back to Nvidia because it sits at the center of how artificial intelligence (AI) is built and used, not just at the edge of the hardware market.

The core of the story is Nvidia's data center business. In the most recent fiscal year (ended Jan. 25, 2026), Nvidia reported quarterly data center revenue of $62.3 billion, up 75% year over year, and full-year data center sales are expected to be in the neighborhood of $180 billion. These are massive numbers and show that data centers are the main engine for the company. When hyperscalers and enterprises decide how many AI clusters to build, they start with Nvidia's platform, then layer everything else around it.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The company's platform is not just about a single AI chip. The company's Blackwell architecture connects hundreds of billions of transistors, custom interconnects, and massive pools of memory into unified graphics processing units (GPUs), then scales those GPUs into rack-level systems like GB200 and GB300 that act like giant accelerators. On top of those systems sit DGX SuperPODs, Grace CPUs, and software like CUDA and TensorRT that developers already know and trust. When I picture the AI factories that companies are building, I see Nvidia in the center of the blueprints.

Nvidia is the early AI stock

All the above is the technical side. The psychological side matters, too. Nvidia has become the default AI stock for many investors. It is the ticker people think of when they hear about new models, new data centers, or new AI enterprise rollouts. Analysts often mention Nvidia first when discussing AI infrastructure, and the stock still carries a broad buy rating and targets pointing to meaningful upside from current levels. That attention can create volatility , yet it also means the company gets a steady stream of capital and scrutiny, which pushes management to keep delivering.

I also look at how Nvidia behaves as a business, not just as a chip designer. It invests in glassmakers, fiber suppliers, networking partners, and data center builders so that the broader ecosystem has what it needs to keep expanding. Nvidia has committed billions of dollars to companies like Corning and data center joint ventures that will eventually become customers for more GPUs and systems. This feels like a company that understands the whole AI stack and is positioning itself to benefit at multiple layers.

Story Continues

Risks regarding Nvidia

There are risks. Custom application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) from Broadcom and others are gaining share in certain workloads, and forecast data suggests GPU servers may represent around 70% of AI server shipments, with ASIC servers approaching 30%. Competition is real. At the same time, Nvidia is pushing new platforms like Blackwell Ultra and Rubin to handle inference, reasoning, and agent-style AI, which shows the company is not standing still while others chase inference efficiency.

For me, the key question is simple: Which semiconductor stock sits closest to the decisions that matter for AI spending? When a cloud provider or a bank plans a new AI system, Nvidia is usually the first name in the room. Its hardware, software, and reference designs still define what an AI cluster looks like, and its data center revenue and backlog tell me customers are willing to keep paying for that leadership.

So when I answer that Nvidia is the top semiconductor stock for 2027 and beyond, I am not just repeating a popular view. I am looking at a company that sells the core of the AI factory, shapes how developers build models, and positions itself along the whole infrastructure chain. If I want exposure to AI chips with the strongest mix of technology, Nvidia is the name I own first and size around everything else.

news.Title: Target Stock Is up 63% This Year, and It's Still Cheap
news.Content:
Investors who left Target (NYSE: TGT) stock for dead have missed out on what's becoming one of 2026's best turnaround stories.

The essentials retailer has dealt with a host of challenges, from inflation putting pressure on its non-essential categories to political public relations messes to increased tariffs. Target stock deflated over the past few years, but its gaining market confidence again, and it's up 63% year to date.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The market is often wary about recovery stories, since they're rare. But Target's is happening .

Things are finally starting to go right

The market was not enthused about the appointment of Michael Fiddelke to the CEO role last year. He's a company insider, and the market was looking for a fresh perspective on the company and its troubles. His recovery plan wasn't especially confidence-boosting either, since it had a whiff of an unoriginal playbook. However, much of the strategy relies on getting the execution right, and management appears to be pulling it off.

There was sustained momentum in the fiscal 2026 second quarter (ended Aug. 1). Comparable sales were up 3.8% year over year, and traffic was up 3.6%. That means more people are coming back to its stores. Much of the growth is coming from digital channels, which had an 8.7% increase in comps versus 2.7% for stores. Same-day options have been a standout for Target throughout its recent problems, and sales increased 25% year over year in the quarter.

There was growth across all six of its categories, with double-digit growth in Fun101 and high single-digit growth in food and beverage and beauty.

One major growth area was store transformation. Target overhauled more stores in this quarter than any other in the past decade, replacing and revamping many areas, including center store grocery assortment. It added extra space for fresh, snacks, bakery, and emerging categories, and snack sales increased 15% after the transition. It also transformed its toy areas, and Fun101, Lego, plush, and Heyday electronics all delivered double-digit comps growth.

It only works, though, if it continues. Chief merchandising officer Cara Sylvetor noted, "These are the kinds of choices we need to make more consistently, staying close to the guest, moving at the speed of culture, and being disciplined about where we invest our space."

Story Continues

The company is also enjoying strength in non-merchandise sales, which grew 20% over last year. These include revenue sources like advertising and its membership program. And it's not just comparable sales. Target opened 17 new stores in the second quarter, and total revenue increased 5.3% over last year.

The future looks even better

Fiddelke noted that there's a ways to go to get back to stability, and there are many signs that it will happen. One encouraging update is how the company is leveraging artificial intelligence to drive sales. It had 3.5 times more direct traffic from external sources like ChatGPT than the year-ago period, and teacher and college wish-list recommendations led to strong digital conversions.

The store renovations demonstrate that it's on the right track, and it's investing in newness, trends, and key collaborations to keep up the momentum. It's launching Target Beauty Studio in 600 stores, and it's redoing other spaces like kids' home and bedding.

Management raised full-year sales growth to about 5%, a full percentage point higher, and earnings per share from a midpoint of $8 to a midpoint of $10.40.

The price is right, too

Target's P/E ratio went as low as 10 recently, and as the stock climbs, it's reached 16.5 at the current price. That still looks like a bargain, especially when compared with competitors Costco Wholesale and Walmart .

As Target's recovery takes shape, you can still buy it it a bargain price. The company is also a Dividend King, and it's raised its dividend annually for the past 55 years. At the current price, the dividend yields 2.9%, and investors can enjoy dividend and stock growth as Target stock makes its way back up.

news.Content:

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Micron's edge in engineering flexibility

Micron's competitive advantage stems from the company's history of treating memory as a connected system rather than a commodity. While competitors continue chasing density milestones, Micron spent decades refining its DRAM and NAND portfolios so that the two can be co-optimized. This strategy is paying off as AI workloads increasingly demand both ultra-low latency and massive sequential throughput.

While this cross-pollination is not featured in headlines, smart investors understand that this approach allows Micron to prototype hybrid memory solutions faster than pure-play rivals such as Samsung or SK Hynix . As a result, Micron can respond swiftly to shifts in AI model architecture without waiting for its external partners to catch up.

Of course, investing in Micron does not come without risk. I'm not talking about the cyclical nature that has historically plagued the memory market, though. Micron's decision to diversify its memory portfolio across data centers, consumer electronics, automotives, and cloud computing can ultimately slow commercial rollouts when customers demand speed and access over perfection.

In an environment where AI labs and hyperscalers prioritize immediate availability over efficiency, Micron's wide reach can leave it temporarily behind more aggressive suppliers. Owning Micron stock requires patience for the company's measured scaling and conviction that this approach will lead to compounding effects or ultimately stagnate the business.

Sandisk's overlooked strength in firmware

Sandisk's narrative largely revolves around its focus on NAND flash. What receives almost no attention is the company's investments in firmware. This is important because these engineering innovations can extend the useful life of lower-cost flash. Given the pace AI infrastructure budgets are growing, Sandisk's ability to offer reliable performance from higher-end NAND offers a subtle cost advantage for hyperscalers.

Story Continues

Despite these advantages, Sandisk's primary liability is its concentration. Simply put, the company is tightly bound to NAND. This means investing in Sandisk requires an acceptance of more binary exposure to the trajectory of flash. Should there be an oversupply of these products, Sandisk's business becomes inherently devalued relative to a diversified peer.

Why pairing Micron with Sandisk makes sense

Another dimension to discuss is the way Micron and Sandisk interact with each other. Micron's broader footprint provides negotiating leverage with equipment suppliers and foundry partners. Meanwhile, Sandisk's narrow focus inherently pushes the performance envelope of next-generation NAND. In turn, this raises customer expectations for all suppliers across the memory value chain, including Micron.

This feedback loop is essentially invisible in price charts, yet it creates a strong mutual reinforcement in which investors should treat these two stocks as complements rather than substitutes. The obvious risk is that this interdependence goes both ways. If one company stumbles, the other's ability to bridge the gap will be constrained by its own specializations or scale limitations. This systemic fragility could amplify industrywide shortages in a more dramatic scenario.

Taken together, I think the lesser-spoken strengths and weaknesses around Micron and Sandisk ultimately point in the same direction. Micron offers architectural flexibility and wide distribution at the cost of more modest commercial scaling. On the other hand, Sandisk brings software-enabled longevity at the cost of product concentration.

Against this backdrop, I think owning both Micron and Sandisk does more than diversify cyclical exposure. Rather, a position in each stock brings more balance in a market that insists on crowning a singular AI champion. In my view, the more durable position is to hold the pair and let their complementary strengths compound throughout the AI infrastructure supercycle.

news.Title: The S&P 500 Just Did Something Seen Only 1 Other Time Since 1871 — and It's Not Good News for Wall Street
news.Content:
Yale economics professor Robert Shiller developed one of the best stock market valuation metrics ever -- the cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings (CAPE) ratio. This ratio measures overall market price-to-earnings multiples, but with a twist. Instead of only looking at earnings over the last four quarters, it uses a 10-year moving average of inflation-adjusted earnings.

Shiller has analyzed U.S. stock market CAPE ratios going back to 1871. That date is well before the creation of the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) in 1957. However, the widely followed index and Shiller's valuation metric have become intertwined, resulting in the S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

I give you this history as background to introduce a recent development. The S&P 500 -- and more specifically, the S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio -- just did something seen only one other time since 1871. And it's not good news for Wall Street.

Image source: Getty Images

40 is a rare number

The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio has remained below 25 throughout most of the U.S. stock market history. From 1871 through 2000, the valuation metric averaged roughly 15.7.

However, the CAPE ratio has spiked occasionally. When stock prices rose sharply, the gap between the S&P 500's valuation and 10-year earnings moving average widened.

Shiller's indicator didn't breach 30 until 1929. After retreating, though, it stayed below that threshold for nearly seven decades. However, in early 1999, the S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio did something unprecedented: It topped 40. Later that year, the metric rose above 41 for the first time. With only a brief dip below the mark, the CAPE ratio stayed at this elevated level until October 2000.

More than two decades passed, with Shiller's valuation metric never rising above 40 -- until recently. In June 2026, the S&P 500 CAPE ratio hit 40 for the second time in 155 years.

S&P 500 Shiller CAPE Ratio data by YCharts

An ominous historical precedent

The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio topping 40 isn't just rare; it's also ominous. At least, that's what history shows.

Sharp increases in the valuation metric have almost always been a worrisome sign for investors. For example, shortly after the CAPE ratio rose above 30 in 1929, the stock market crashed , and the Great Depression began.

Story Continues

You might remember what happened the last time the S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio crossed 40 in 1999. It remained high for a while, then the bottom fell out. The dot-com bubble burst, with the S&P 500 eventually falling more than 45% below its peak. It took nearly seven years for the index to recover fully.

^SPX data by YCharts

Invesco (NYSE:IVZ) analyzed historical stock market returns during periods following elevated CAPE ratios. The asset manager found that the S&P 500 has delivered negative annualized returns over the next decade when the CAPE ratio surges to frothy levels.

The S&P 500 CAPE ratio has a track record of reversion to its mean. There are only two ways this reversion can occur: Either the S&P 500's valuation declines, or earnings increase significantly. The former is much easier than the latter.

What should investors do?

Investors today shouldn't panic, though. For one thing, this time may be different from the past. The S&P 500's earnings are rising faster than valuations. That wasn't the case during the dot-com bubble, when many publicly traded companies were losing money hand over fist.

However, a historically high S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio shouldn't be ignored. It could be an omen of negative stock market returns in the near future, just as it has been in the past.

The smartest strategy for investors is to focus on the stocks of high-quality businesses with strong long-term growth prospects and reasonable valuations relative to this growth. Building cash could also be a prudent move to be able to take advantage of a steep market sell-off if one occurs.

This is the approach that Warren Buffett is taking, by the way. And he knows a thing or two about reading the tea leaves with the stock market.

news.Title: 3 Tech Compounders Fit for Warren Buffett's Portfolio
news.Content:
Legendary investor Warren Buffett loves investing in great compounding businesses with wide moats at attractive valuations. While he has largely avoided tech stocks in the past, that has changed in the last few years, with him leading the charge with investments in Apple and Alphabet .

Let's look at three tech stocks that would be great fits for Warren Buffett's portfolio , even if he is unlikely to buy the stocks anytime soon.

Meta Platforms

Few companies know how to monetize free users better than Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META), and that is only getting better through the use of AI. The company has the perfect flywheel business model for AI, where its investments in improved models are keeping users on its sites longer and helping advertisers better convert them to customers. This is turn is leading to both more ad impressions and higher ad prices due to the increased effectiveness of the ads.

With over 3.5 billion daily active users from around the globe, Meta enjoys massive global network effects and scale efficiencies. The company produces massive operating cash flow that it can now invest in high return investments in AI, keeping the flywheel going. Meanwhile, the stock is on sale, trading at a forward P/E below 16 times 2027 analyst estimates.

The one thing likely keeping Buffett from owning the stock, though, is CEO Mark Zuckerberg's penchant for wasting money with Reality Labs. However, this is a stock that's still a buy in my book.

Microsoft

Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) has a huge enterprise lock-in with Office 365, which gives it both solid pricing power and the vehicle to provide AI tools and agents to a huge customer base. With trusted security and guardrails in place, Microsoft has been seeing strong adoption of its Microsoft 365 AI assistant Copilot, which has been driving strong growth in its enterprise software segment.

Meanwhile, Buffett has already shown a fondness for the economics of cloud computing, given his investment in Alphabet. Microsoft Azure shares similar characteristics with strong, steady revenue growth. The company also has one of the largest backlogs in the space given its relationship with OpenAI.

Even after a recent jump in price, the stock is still attractively valued, trading at 24.5 times this fiscal year's analyst earnings consensus. It also owns a 27% stake in OpenAI, which could become the next $1 trillion IPO.

Story Continues

The one thing that likely keeps Buffett away from the stock is his soured relationship with Microsoft founder Bill Gates. However, the stock still looks like an attractive buy.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing

The arms dealer in the AI infrastructure boom, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM) has an unassailable competitive moat built around its engineering expertise and scale. As the only foundry that has proven to produce advanced logic chips at high yields at scale, the company has created a virtual monopoly in the space.

This has given the company huge customer lock-in and pricing power. It's become a vital cog in the semiconductor industry and an important partner to chipmakers, which basically have to coordinate with TSMC on their technological roadmaps and capacity expansion plans. While semiconductor manufacturing is a capital-intensive business, this ensures that the company gets strong returns on its investments.

Buffett has called TSMC "one of the best-managed companies and most important companies in the world," while it has also garnered praise from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who called it "one of the greatest companies in the history of humanity, and anybody who wants to buy TSMC stock is a very smart person." That's some high praise, yet the stock remains cheap, with a forward P/E of just 19 times 2027 analyst estimates.

While Buffett was briefly invested in the stock in the past, geopolitical tensions have kept him from making it a long-term investment. However, that seems like a long-shot black swan event, and those fears should not keep investors from buying this great stock.

news.Title: President Donald Trump Claims Fuel Prices Are "Tumbling Down," but Trumpflation Has Become a Broad-Based Problem
news.Content:
Look up the word "resiliency" in a dictionary, and you'd probably see a photo of the U.S. stock market, which has been climbing a wall of worry for years. Since early June, the time-tested Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJINDICES: ^DJI), benchmark S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC), and innovation-driven Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX: ^IXIC) have each blasted to record highs.

This ongoing outperformance has occurred despite concerns of an artificial intelligence (AI) bubble taking shape, and with outstanding margin debt soaring. But the biggest risk of all to the high-flying stock market is above-average inflation .

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Although modest inflation (rising prices) is perfectly normal for an expanding economy, actions taken by President Donald Trump have directly affected domestic prices. While the president has assured the public that prices will come "tumbling down" once the Iran war is over, Trumpflation data tells a completely different story .

President Trump pitches lower fuel costs to consumers

Trumpflation (inflation that's specifically driven by President Trump's policies) comes in two forms: tariffs and the Iran war.

For more than a year, Fed Chairs Jerome Powell and Kevin Warsh have cited the president's tariffs as modestly lifting consumer prices in the goods sector. With the Trump administration recently imposing a new round of sweeping global tariffs, ranging from 10% to 12.5% on more than 80 countries, this inflationary dynamic is expected to continue.

However, the more prominent source of inflation has been the Iran war. Shortly after President Trump green-lit military operations against Iran, the latter shut down the Strait of Hormuz to virtually all maritime traffic. This essentially halted the flow of a fifth of the world's petroleum liquids.

In the weeks that followed, gas prices skyrocketed at the fastest pace in three decades. This parabolic increase in fuel prices, in the wake of the largest modern-day energy supply disruption, almost single-handedly sent trailing 12-month inflation (TTM) to a three-year high of 4.2% in May.

However, President Trump has been adamant that Iran war-driven inflation, including elevated fuel prices, will come crashing down once the conflict is resolved.

In March, the president responded to reporters by stating, "Well, I think your gas prices, as soon as that's over, are going to come tumbling down along with everything else."

Story Continues

Three months later, in mid-June, the White House (courtesy of President Trump) tweeted that "oil is flowing and gas prices have begun tumbling down, now below $4 per gallon nationally."

The prospect of peace talks between the U.S. and Iran has indeed driven West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude oil prices well below their Iran war highs. Although fuel prices react to the upside almost immediately when energy supply shocks occur, they historically fall like a feather once these supply issues are resolved.

While fuel prices aren't exactly "tumbling down" as the president put it, they have notably retraced in recent months.

Unfortunately for consumers and the stock market, energy prices aren't the headline story any longer.

Trumpflation is becoming entrenched in the broader economy -- and that's a big - time problem

On the surface, the June and July inflation reports appear to be a silver lining for consumers, with TTM inflation falling to 3.5% in June (down from 4.2% in May) and 3.4% in July. But an all-important inflation figure points to Trumpflation digging its proverbial heels into the broader economy.

In May, when headline inflation hit a three-year high of 4.2%, Core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) reached 3.4%, its highest level since October 2023. Core PCE excludes volatile food and energy costs, providing economists and investors with a clearer understanding of long-term price trends.

While headline inflation has retraced by 80 basis points to 3.4% over the last two months, Core PCE for June eased to just 3.3%. According to the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland's Inflation Nowcasting tool, Core PCE is projected to essentially hover at 3.29% in July and 3.34% in August. The price stickiness of this all-important measure of inflation indicates that the effects of Trumpflation have moved well beyond the energy sector.

For instance, some businesses have been forced to reroute shipments, change transportation methods entirely, or alter their suppliers in lieu of the Strait of Hormuz's closure. These changes are increasing production costs that businesses are, in many cases, passing on to consumers. This structural inflation is considerably tougher to remove than generally short-lived energy supply shocks.

Trumpflation becoming a broad-based economic issue is terrible news for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh and his central bank colleagues, as well as the stock market.

Since Kevin Warsh was sworn in as Fed chair on May 22, Treasury bond yields at the long end of the yield curve have soared, highlighted by the 30-year yield hitting a 25-year high. But if Trumpflation digs in its heels, it's going to take more than just bond traders to deliver price stability. Warsh and the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) may be forced to act and raise the federal funds target rate to bring prices down.

Trumpflation prompting the FOMC to raise interest rates wouldn't go over well on Wall Street. The AI data center build-out is the primary catalyst responsible for lifting the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite to new heights. The otherworldly spending on this infrastructure build-out is being partially financed using debt. If lending costs rise and the AI build-out slows, even marginally, it could spell disaster for the second-priciest stock market in history.

Even if the Iran war officially ends relatively soon, the inflationary effects of Trumpflation should stick around for a while.

news.Title: 1 Overlooked Dividend King With a 63-Year Winning Streak Worth Buying Now
news.Content:
Dividend Kings are a relatively small group of dominant businesses that have increased their dividends for at least 50 consecutive years. Two of the most widely held consumer goods names on the list are Coca-Cola and Walmart , but investors shouldn't ignore the market leader in toothpaste.

Colgate-Palmolive (NYSE: CL) has raised its dividend for 63 straight years. The company recently declared another quarterly payment of $0.53 per share, following a 1.9% increase earlier this year. That puts the stock's forward (12-month) yield at an above-average 2.34%.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Here's why Colgate looks built to pay dividends for a lifetime.

Repeat sales support growing dividends

Colgate is the top toothpaste brand, with a 41% global market share in 2025. Oral care accounts for nearly half of the business, which helps keep demand steady throughout the year. Personal care, home care, and Hill's Pet Nutrition round out a portfolio that generates about $20 billion in annual sales.

Investing in a toothpaste brand can make for an ideal dividend investment because consumer demand is driven by habit. Most people stick with one brand for years, which helps explain why Colgate remains such a durable business.

Over the last 10 years, total revenue has grown consistently at a low single-digit annual rate. The dividend has followed a similar path, rising about 3% annually.

Colgate pays out a high share of earnings (about 83%). However, the payout ratio is much lower relative to free cash flow at 43%, which is the better yardstick for dividend safety, as it reflects the cash flow a business generates after expenses and capital spending. Free cash flow also rose 14% year over year on a trailing-12-month basis. That cushion gives Colgate room to maintain -- and keep raising -- its dividend even if growth slows in a recession.

Investors can expect steady growth

Colgate's competitive moat is built on strong brands and global distribution. It sells in more than 200 countries, and its strongest growth last quarter came from emerging markets, led by India, Brazil, Mexico, and China.

Dividend investors should also look for improving efficiency. Management has been using artificial intelligence (AI) to sharpen marketing, support market share gains, and manage costs. This should ultimately lead to free cash flow and earnings that grow slightly faster than revenue.

Story Continues

Analysts expect earnings to grow around 5% annually. With sticky consumer demand and steady sales, Colgate can be the kind of dividend compounder investors hold for years.

news.Title: Is Walmart Stock a Buy as It Sinks to Nearly $100 per Share? Here's the Answer.
news.Content:
By all appearances, Walmart (NASDAQ: WMT) generally reported decent results for its fiscal 2027 second-quarter earnings on Aug. 20. But by the end of the day, the stock had slumped more than 9%.

That may be an overreaction in the short term, however, as history has shown that Walmart has been able to navigate through difficult terrain.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What happened in the quarter

For the second quarter of its fiscal 2027, Walmart reported that revenue climbed by 5.9%, with a 23% surge in global e-commerce revenue. In addition, Walmart also raised its net sales forecast for the year, expecting an increase of 4% to 5%, up from a previous forecast of 3.5% to 4.5%. The retailer also projects adjusted earnings will fall in the range of $2.80 to $2.97 per share, up from previous expectations of $2.75 to $2.85.

Walmart also shared with CNBC that it will receive about $2.9 billion in tariff refunds and plans to use the funds to lower prices for shoppers .

That said, the stock still declined by 9% on the day. What seemed to worry investors was that U.S. comparable sales grew by only 2.6%, which was less than the 3.5% expected by analysts, according to FactSet data shared by CNBC. Other issues were that net income dipped from $7 billion in the prior-year period to $6.3 billion for the second quarter of 2027, and Walmart also expects to incur more than $2 billion in costs related to higher fuel prices.

Is Walmart stock a buy?

Walmart certainly has challenges to overcome, but it still has two big investing appeals: its Dividend King status and its newer revenue generators. It won't be a massive income source for anyone who buys shares, as the dividend yield is only 0.9%. That said, it's more about what that Dividend King title means than the payout itself.

Walmart has increased its dividend payout for 53 consecutive years. That means it increased its payouts during stagflation and inflation. It also means it increased dividend payouts during the 2008 financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. Because some companies lacked financial strength during periods of tough economic conditions, they had to drastically cut or even pause their payouts. In comparison, Walmart never had to do that in the past 53 years and had a strong enough balance sheet to keep boosting dividend payouts.

Story Continues

For its newer revenue generators, Walmart showcased them in this recent quarter. Net additions to its Walmart+ subscription service hit a new high, and global advertising revenue jumped 38%. The retailer is also seeing strong engagement with its artificial intelligent shopping agent, Sparky. The number of customers who used Sparky was up 70% from last year, and those who used Sparky spent 40% more than non-Sparky users.

So while Walmart may presently be facing a bit of a tough stretch, over the long run, the company has shown it knows how to handle uncertainty and has ultimately rewarded long-term investors. Just over the last five years alone, the Walmart stock price has climbed 105% compared to the S&P 500 's 72% return. For those who plan on holding for the long term, this looks like an appealing time to pick up some shares.

news.Title: Alphabet and Amazon Are Cheaper Than the S&P 500. What's Going On?
news.Content:
Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) and Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) look cheaper than the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) at face value. Right now, Alphabet and Amazon trade for 17 and 20.9 times earnings, respectively. The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) trades for 24.2 times earnings, making these two far cheaper than the broader market.

Considering that Alphabet and Amazon are two of the most popular big tech stocks available and both are growing at an incredible pace, this difference seems odd. So, what gives? Are these two actually screaming values begging to be bought, or is there something else going on here? Let's take a look.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Alphabet and Amazon each have one-time effects skewing their earnings

The price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio is the most popular tool investors use to value stocks, but it is far from perfect. Earnings per share (EPS) can be skewed in a variety of ways, and some of them are completely out of the company's control. One way this happens is thanks to gains on investments.

Both Alphabet and Amazon have extensive investment portfolios, and each has seen their holdings dramatically rise in value this year. Both Amazon and Alphabet are major investors in Anthropic, the AI firm whose flagship model is Claude. Anthropic is expected to go public in the near future, with reports circling that it's targeting a $2 trillion valuation. However, Amazon and Alphabet's reported gains are based on Anthropic's latest funding round, which saw the firm valued at $965 billion at the end of May.

Even though neither Amazon nor Alphabet sold their stake in Anthropic, generally accepted accounting practices (GAAP) require them to report the gain as an increase in earnings. This causes the EPS metric to rise without them selling, thus skewing Amazon and Alphabet's P/E ratio.

Alphabet also had another investment produce a huge gain, as Space Exploration Technologies , better known as SpaceX, generated a massive gain for Alphabet during its second quarter. In fact, Alphabet produced $98 billion in "other income" during Q2, mostly from the gains it has on paper from Anthropic and SpaceX's rise.

This explains why Alphabet and Amazon look so cheap, but are they actually cheap?

Amazon and Alphabet are still solid deals.

Story Continues

There are a handful of ways to value these stocks that don't include the one-off effects from gains on investments. One way is to look at earnings projections for the next fiscal year. These projections don't include any gains on investments, because those are impossible to forecast. Instead, they just utilize where analysts think the company's primary businesses will go, and both Amazon and Alphabet are still valued at reasonable levels from this perspective.

With Amazon trading at 25 times next year's earnings and Alphabet at 23 times next year's earnings, the premium investors have to pay for these two stocks is familiar. But these prices are still fairly reasonable to pay considering the leading role these two play in the AI arms race. Both of these companies are major cloud computing providers and are spending hundreds of billions of dollars to build out computing capacity for AI firms to utilize. This is leading to massive growth rates for both companies, and each is growing at its fastest pace in years as a result.

Both Amazon and Alphabet are long-term beneficiaries of this trend, and I think they will be incredible investments over the next decade. With each stock still trading at a reasonable valuation, yet their growth rates accelerating due to huge growth, now is the perfect time to buy.

news.Title: 台股漲贏費半！胡睿涵看本週4大觀察重點 提醒留意長債風暴
news.Content:
〔記者張慧雯／台北報導〕上週五台股再次出現「拉積盤」，然而扣掉台積電(2330)大盤只漲8點，然而上週五美股漲多跌少，台積電、聯電ADR都收紅，台股漲勢甚至強過費半；元大投顧董事長胡睿涵認為，業績強就是台股的底氣，但本週還是有可能出現「AI股仍不穩，得繼續由傳金再穩盤一週」的局面，籌碼會進行第二波清洗，AI主流股攻勢才有機會再起；不過她也提醒散戶要觀察四大重點，留意長債風暴的風險。

胡睿涵分析，道瓊、納指、標普在高檔第一階橫盤強勢整理，費半指數則是較弱，仍處於「第二階橫盤整理」，台股很特別，集中市場走勢強過費半，因為台灣是美國AI工廠，美國大廠資本支出增加，台灣接單就先獲利，從台灣外銷接單頻創歷史新高即可佐證；也因此，台灣科技廠業績強是台股最重要的底氣，所以集中市場在「高檔第一階」橫盤強勢整理，至於櫃買走勢較像費半偏弱，還在第二階繼續橫盤整理。

她認為，上週電子AI股忽漲忽跌，傳產金融逆勢崛起，本週很可能由傳產金融再撐盤勢一週左右，等待籌碼第二波清洗，屆時AI主流股才有機會攻勢再起，由於整理盤因為很難操作，本來就不太會有量，所以此刻「量能」不是重點 ，關鍵在類股輪動是否健康，而健康的定義則是「某類股持續3日以上轉強，且技術籌碼面都要轉強」。

她也直指接下來市場有四大觀察重點，第一，美財政部即使再加碼長天期公債回購金額，美國10年、20年、30年公債殖利率有真的走跌且持續？第二，聯準會主席華許即將在全球央行年會演說，可從中尋找利率走向、通膨及央行獨立性的線索，第三，輝達週三盤後公布財報，市場聚焦AI晶片需求、規模達5000億美元的融資計畫，以及市場是否買單？第四，美元指數續貶？黃金是否續漲？(黃金連漲三週也是風險升高警訊) 。

胡睿涵最後也提醒，投資人若再次見到美、歐、日的10年、20年、30年長天期公債殖利率仍頻創新高，全世界「長債風暴」很可能會從美國擴散到全世界，畢竟市場的黑天鵝總是無法預料，投資人進場仍需多一份警覺心。

news.Title: This 401(k) Move Could Cost Retirees Up to $487 a Month for a Year
news.Content: When you withdraw money from a 401(k), you probably already know that you have to consider the effect on your tax rate. Too large a withdrawal could push you into a higher tax bracket by increasing your household income. Withdrawing too much from your account could also put you at risk of draining the account if you don't leave enough invested. There's another risk, though. If you aren't careful, it's possible that a ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Large 401(k) withdrawals can unexpectedly increase Medicare Part B premiums due to the Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount (IRMAA).
• Withdrawals can increase Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI), potentially pushing retirees above thresholds that trigger higher premiums.
• For single filers, MAGI above $109,000 can lead to increased premiums, while for married joint filers, the threshold is $218,000.
• A withdrawal pushing MAGI above $500,000 (single) or $750,000 (married joint) could result in an additional $487 per month in Part B premiums.
• Strategies to mitigate this include spacing out withdrawals over two years or making large withdrawals/Roth conversions before age 63.
news.Keywords: retirement planning, Medicare premiums, IRMAA, withdrawal strategy, MAGI

news.Title: 《台股盤後》量縮收漲290點、重返5日線；週K翻黑
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-21 16:14:43 新聞中心 發佈

美股週四及日股今(21)日跌勢壓力下，台股在載板族群、川湖續走弱下，早盤一度下跌近350點，惟在台積電、南亞科續強，搭配電子權值指標股聯發科、台達電回神，同時傳產權值指標也有南亞、台化、中鋼轉強，且兩大壽險金控盤中明顯拉升，而19大類股又漲多跌少下，大盤指數穩步走高，順利站回45000點大關，終場收在45224.29點，上漲290.55點或0.65%、日K翻紅，重返5日線，成交量再萎縮至7192.80億元；惟週K仍翻黑，本週共計下跌586.72點或1.28%。

雖然美國財政部祭出超乎尋常的公債回購操作，殖利率卻僅回跌一天就彈回原先水位，再加上美伊關係緊張推升油價，衝擊道瓊工業平均指數、那斯達克指數與標準普爾500指數收低，惟費半指數對應週三的跌勢見小幅反彈約0.5%。亞洲股市方面，因中東情勢衝擊投資人信心，拖累日經225指數走軟，收跌0.30%；韓國KOSPI指數則受惠三星電子也祭出庫藏股效應、收漲0.88%。

台股今日電子權值股走勢不同調，台積電收在最高點2410元、上漲1.47%，DRAM指標股南亞科也續強收漲2%，聯發科則止跌反彈逾2%，華邦電、聯電、台達電亦同步收紅，為加權指數今日的漲勢奠定了穩固基礎，不過，台光電則下挫逾半根停板，奇鋐、川湖、健策、智邦都走弱，同時載板族群也遭賣壓襲擊，欣興盤中一度殺至跌停，不過隨後跌勢收斂、終場收跌近5%，南電、景碩、臻鼎-KY亦連袂走跌。

在29大類股表現上，資金明顯回流傳產族群，今日漲幅最高的三大類股分別為油電燃氣漲3.42%，航運業漲3.37%，塑膠漲3.08%。其中，航運族群受惠運價維持高檔、供需轉趨緊俏，成為近日盤面焦點，帶動萬海衝上漲停，陽明、長榮也分別上漲6%、2%。至於跌勢部分，電子零組件下跌2.65%、電機機械下跌2.1%、電腦及週邊設備下跌1.65%，為表現最差的三大族群。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人合計買超331.06億元；其中，自營商買超29.23億元，投信買超18.78億元，外資及陸資買超283.05億元。

news.Title: 「從185→115元」聯電怎麼了？ 陳重銘揭關鍵支撐：有望補漲
news.Content:
晶圓代工大廠聯電（2303）近期股價表現疲弱，自6月底創下新高185.5元後，近日已回落至115元附近。對此，財經作家「不敗教主」陳重銘表示，由於聯電股價波動較大，不建議投資人因短線上漲而盲目追高。

陳重銘在臉書發文分析，晶圓雙雄若以長期投資的角度來看，優先選擇台積電，台積電具備先進製程優勢，且第二季毛利率高達約67%，遠高於聯電的32%，使其在長期競爭力及穩定性方面具備明顯優勢，適合列為長線核心持股。

不過這並不代表聯電沒有表現機會，陳重銘指出，當台積電股價處於相對高檔時，資金有可能流向聯電，帶動補漲行情，值得投資人進一步觀察。

陳重銘提到，從基本面來看，聯電第二季財報亮眼，單季每股盈餘達3.39元，今年上半年EPS累計4.68元，不過他也提醒，其中逾2元來源於業外收益，須注意不可全然視為本業獲利，預估今年本業EPS約為5元，若加計業外獲利，全年EPS有機會接近7元。

至於本益比，陳重銘分析，以目前115元股價對照本業EPS的5元來看，聯電本益比約為22倍，與台積電評價差距並不如市場預期般大，因此聯電股價未來走勢仍需觀察本業營運，以及產能利用率表現，現階段第二季產能利用率約85%，預料第三季有望提升至9成，屆時成長動能值得關注。

陳重銘補充，聯電股價先前下探至102元，100元為重要支撐區，未來若再度回落至此區間，可觀察是否出現止跌訊號；他建議，聯電較適合於股價跌深後分批承接，把握波段操作機會；若目標為長期投資，台積電依然為首選。

（封面圖/翻攝自聯電官網）

news.Title: 大華銀韓國KOSPI 50今登場，強勢躋身今年被動ETF成交前三名
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】全台首檔專注於韓國頂尖科技與產業龍頭的「大華韓國KOSPI 50」(009829)於今(21)日正式掛牌上市。受惠於韓國晶片巨頭財報亮眼與AI算力需求持續噴發，009829上市首日即引爆市場買氣，早盤股價強勢走高，終場爆量大漲，開盤兩小時成交量即突破10萬張，強勢登頂今日海外股票型被動ETF成交量冠軍寶座。大華銀韓國KOSPI 50(009829)掛牌首日即成為市場焦點，開紅盤再創發行價新高，該檔ETF收盤價10.74元，全日成交量達13.8萬張，居今年以來被動ETF掛牌首日成交量前三名。國際投資機構紛紛出具最新研究報告看好韓股後續爆發力。高盛（Goldman Sachs）等外資投行最新分析指出，韓國股市在經歷前期散戶融資部位快速清洗後，籌碼去槓桿化已宣告完成，系統性風險大幅降解。

大華銀投信指數量化投資部門主管郭修誠表示，隨著全球雲端服務巨頭（Hyperscalers）對AI基礎建設資本支出不減反增，高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的供需緊缺將延續至2027年，長約機制更奠定韓系記憶體龍頭長線高毛利的基石。彭博（Bloomberg）數據顯示，KOSPI 50指數預估未來一年EPS成長率高達224%，冠絕全球主要股市，然而預估本益比卻僅約6.1倍，呈現極度顯著的「高成長、低估值」倒掛現象，加上南韓政府推動Value-Up政策與挹注5兆韓元半導體基金，韓股正處於第四季評價修復（Rerating）與政策做多的雙重起漲點。

大華銀韓國KOSPI 50(009829)最新前十大持股(截至2026/8/20)，前兩大核心成分股SK海力士（31.79%）與三星電子（31.58%）合計權重超過六成，直接掌握全球逾八成HBM產能與AI晶片代工升級紅利，輔以SK Square（3.18%）深化記憶體鏈影響力；三星電機（2.52%）則鎖定AI伺服器高階被動元件與基板需求；針對AI算力帶動的龐大電力與基建缺口，斗山重工業（1.09%）接獲北美核能大單，三星物產（1.14%）展現頂尖工程建構實力；現代汽車（1.87%）攜手Boston Dynamics布局人形機器人，引領實體AI轉型；韓國國民銀行金融集團（1.67%）與新韓金融集團（1.39%）則大幅受惠政府政策性提高股利與庫藏股銷毀，提供穩健高殖利率護城河；韓華航空航天（1.30%）更受惠全球國防軍工強勁訂單。前十大持股軟硬兼備，全方位反映韓國核心經濟的長線成長趨勢。

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資連2買！台積電單日吸金近140億元 狂掃5檔金融股
news.Content:
（下午4點51分新增外資買賣超個股）

台股今（21）日開低走高，終場收在45,224點，上漲290點，持續守住4萬5千點關卡。今日三大法人買盤持續回流，合計買超331.05億元；外資今日再加碼283.05億元，連續2個交易日站在買方，累計買超356.23億元。啟發投顧分析師丁彥鈞表示，外資近期態度由賣轉買，背後關鍵與美債殖利率走勢有關，台股重新獲得外資青睞目前外資「還沒買完」，買盤有機會一路延續至9月。觀察個股買賣超，外資今日狂掃5檔金融股擠進買超前十大；陽明（2609）則獲買超3.7萬張奪冠，台積電（2330）也吸金近140億元。

外資今日買超前三大：陽明、凱基金、台新新光金

外資今日買盤以航運、金融股為主，其中陽明（2609）獲大買3.7萬張居冠；凱基金（2883）獲加碼3.6萬張排名第二；台新新光金（2887）則獲買超2.1萬張，位居第三。

值得注意的是，金融股成為外資今日掃貨重心，第一金（2892）、富邦金（2881）、兆豐金（2886）也分別獲買超2.4萬張及1.9萬張，前十大買超榜就有5檔金融股入列。

值得注意的是台積電（2330）也獲外資買超逾5,795張，若以今日收盤價估算，外資單日加碼金額約139.66億元。

外資今日賣超前三大：漢翔、00981A、00403A

外資今日賣盤以漢翔（2634）最重，遭賣超2.8萬張居冠；主動統一台股增長（00981A）遭調節2.6萬張排名第二；主動統一升級50（00403A）則遭砍1.3萬張，位居第三。

其餘賣超方面，緯創（3231）遭外資調節9,592張，主動國泰動能高息（00400A）也遭賣超7,746張。

分析師揭「回頭買台股」關鍵：還會繼續買

丁彥鈞表示，外資近期由賣轉買，主要與美債市場變化有關，隨著美國財政部買回美債，美債價格逐漸止穩、殖利率不再持續攀升，資金停留在美國債市的吸引力相對降低，也讓外資重新將目光轉向台股。

他指出，從今日盤面觀察，外資資金可能主要集中在台積電（2330）與金融股，而這波外資買盤能維持多久？丁彥鈞認為，目前外資雖然已經連續2日買超，但以外資整體資金規模來看，「買超還不算多」，加上美國財政部後續仍可能擴大美債買回，因此預期外資回補台股趨勢尚未結束，「還會繼續買」，甚至有機會延續至9月。

丁彥鈞表示，短線台股仍可偏多看待，若外資買盤持續回流，投資人可留意外資主要加碼方向，包括台積電與金融股，「可以搭外資的順風車」；後續則持續觀察美債殖利率及外資買超是否延續。

外資連2買 今再加碼283億元

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計買超331.05億元。其中，外資今日加碼283億元，延續買超態勢，連續2個交易日買超，累計回補356.23億元。

投信今日也持續站在買方，買超18.77億元，終止連2賣。自營商則同步站在買方，合計買超29.22億元，其中自行買賣買超29.09億元，避險操作買超0.13億元。

台股今日在權值股帶動持續上揚，加權指數終場收在45,224點，上漲290點，成交金額約7,440億元；權王台積電（2330）終場收在2,410元，上漲35元。

news.Title: 日經週五收低0.30%，東證指數小漲0.19%，半導體、銀行及汽車股撐盤
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】日本股市週五走勢震盪，因市場對美國公債回購計畫的疑慮重燃，推高了美國公債殖利率，加上中東緊張局勢升級推高了油價，也影響了投資者信心。收盤時，東證第一部指數上揚7.56點或0.19%，報4,067.29點；日經225指數下滑200.43點或0.30%，報66,016.36點。

三井住友DS資產管理公司首席市場策略分析師Masahiro Ichikawa表示，美國公債殖利率上升、中東局勢不明朗以及油價上漲令通膨擔憂揮之不去，可能引發日股拋售壓力。不過，一旦外部不利因素舒緩，強勁的企業獲利應該會吸引買家重返日本股市。

儘管美國財政部長斯科特貝森特週四暗示可能擴大股票回購規模並即將推出財政計劃，但美國公債殖利率仍上漲。長期日本公債殖利率攀升，跟隨美國公債走勢。

Resona Holdings策略分析師Hiroki Takei表示，長期殖利率繼續拖累市場情緒。不過，鑒於日本股市在以往殖利率上升的時期都保持了韌性，因此沒有必要過於悲觀。

東證指數收復了早盤的部分失地，銀行股提供了一定的支撐。

Tokai Tokyo Intelligence Laborator市場分析師Shuutarou Yasuda表示，估值較高的半導體股票在這種環境下很難吸引買家。當利率上升時，那些遙遠的未來收益會被大幅折價。

此外，日本政府週五公佈的數據顯示，7月剔除生鮮食品項目後核心消費者價格年比值上漲1.8%，與24位受訪經濟專家的預測中值相符，預估區間介於上漲1.6%至上漲2.2%。

個股表現方面，服飾品牌優衣庫母公司迅銷股價下跌3.63%；記憶體晶片製造商鎧俠股價上揚2.59%；營收逾三成來自北美市場的汽車製造大廠豐田汽車股價揚升2.15%；金融控股業者三菱日聯金融集團股價上漲1.27%；能源開採商國際石油開發帝石股價上升2.20%。

news.Title: 【台股盤後】持續量縮震盪　權值股撐盤終場漲290.55點
news.Content:
（中央社記者江明晏台北2026年08月21日電）台股今天開低震盪，終場上漲290.55點，收在45224.29點，重返45000點，但成交量縮；台積電、聯發科等權值股勁揚，貨櫃三雄強漲，載板族群震盪收黑。投顧分析，量能未明顯放大，短線盤勢估震盪整理，後續關注美國貨幣政策與輝達財報。

美股20日主要指數多收低，油價上漲引發市場對通膨的擔憂。道瓊工業指數挫跌703.84點；費城半導體指數上漲0.53%。

台股今天以44923點開低，早盤震盪後翻紅，盤中最高45254點，上漲逾300點，終場收在45224.29點，上漲290.55點，漲幅0.65%，成交值量縮至新台幣7192.8億元。電子指數漲0.37%，金融指數漲2.53%，代表中小型股的櫃買OTC指數下跌0.69%。

權值股勁揚，台積電漲近1.5%，聯發科漲逾2%、台達電、聯電收紅。

記憶體族群強勢，南亞科、華邦電收漲逾2%，載板三雄震盪收黑，欣興、景碩、南電跌約5%。

貨櫃三雄強漲，萬海收漲停，陽明漲逾6%、長榮漲逾2%。

觀察高價股走勢，股王信驊、股后川湖疲軟收黑，新代跌停，竑騰、聯友金屬漲停，均華漲停登上千金股，旭隼、金像電等跌破千元關卡，台股收盤擁46千金股。

台新投顧總經理黃文清向中央社記者表示，台股今天雖呈現震盪，但走勢比市場原先預期強勁。這波自低點反彈以來，累計漲幅已達17%，逐漸接近前波套牢區，但成交量並未明顯放大，顯示市場交易心態仍偏保守，短線上攻力道有限，盤勢可能轉為震盪整理。

展望後市，黃文清認為，首先要觀察油價走勢及貨幣政策變化。市場普遍預期美國聯準會9月將維持利率不變，但後續通膨數據仍是市場關注焦點，也可能成為影響行情的不確定因素。

其次，輝達將公布財報，市場目前普遍抱持正面期待，但由於投資人預期已高，須留意「利多不漲」的情況。整體而言，台股偏多趨勢尚未改變，但短線震盪整理恐難避免。

news.Title: 台積電尾盤強拉！台股收漲290點 航運股衝高「4檔」收漲停
news.Content:
台股今（21）日開低走高，早盤一度下挫逾300點，所幸後續翻紅成功重返45K關卡，終場收45224點，上漲290點，漲幅0.65%，成交量來到7100億。

權值股部分，台積電及台塑四寶為今日指數翻紅的反攻要角，台積電早盤以平盤開出，股價一路走高，尾盤更是有4045張買單推升大盤指數，終場收2410元，站回2400元關卡，上漲35元，漲幅1.47%；台塑四寶中，南亞收192元，漲幅3.23%，台塑化來到75.8元，上漲3.84%，台塑、台化也分別有2.77%、2.91%的漲幅。

觀察今日盤面，航運類股上攻，受惠於財報繳出亮眼成績，航運三雄萬海收漲停來到124.5元，陽明收漲6.14%，長榮也有2.24%的漲幅，其餘航運股也受激勵，益航、中櫃、四維航同步收漲停。

news.Title: 台積電連2天神擺尾！台股收盤漲290點站回45K 成交量縮到窒息
news.Content:
台股今（21）日回神重返4萬5大關，雖然早盤一度下探44583.87點，但靠著台積電撐盤隨後翻紅，收盤上漲290.55點收45224.29點，但成交量縮至7193億，創近期新低量。

台積電連2天拉尾盤，今收盤漲35元至2410元。聯發科股價在連跌四天後反彈逾2%，美系外資出具最新報告，強調Google採取多供應商策略，聯發科有機會在競爭加劇的環境下，繼續實現大幅的絕對營收成長。

航運族群逆勢撐盤，萬海強鎖124.5元漲停表現最強勢，陽明大漲近6%，長榮漲近2%，散裝航運股四維航同步漲停。記憶體亦上漲，南亞科漲逾2%。

廖祿民分析師指出，美債殖利率反彈加上油價上漲，使通膨疑慮升高，台股持續在四萬五附近震盪測試支撐，市場觀望氣氛濃厚。楊少凱分析師表示，台股若要挑戰前高須補量。

台股昨上漲214點收44,933點，收復季線，但成交量僅8344.1億元，創下三周來新低。

美股道瓊下跌703.84點或1.32%，收52,759.21點。S&P500下跌66.82點或0.87%，收7,641.16點。NASDAQ下跌263.93點或1.00%，收26,067.17點。費城半導體上漲61.79點或0.53%，收11,800.02點。

news.Title: 台股開低反攻量能收斂，台積、聯發科穩盤，航運及低PE個股輪動
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股大盤今早開低後隨即反攻，台積電(2330)與聯發科(2454)再次扮演穩住大盤的重要角色。不過，從預估成交量來看，市場量能似乎又有收斂跡象，顯示短線成交量逐步萎縮，對大盤多頭力道形成一定壓力。　　換言之，在成交量收縮的情況下，大型權值股較難進一步推升指數，目前主要仍以穩盤為主。因此，短線盤面焦點可能逐漸轉向其他類股，尤其是航運股及本益比較低的個股，值得留意資金輪動的機會。

事實上，近期日本、香港等國際航運類股已出現明顯上漲，部分甚至創下新高，台灣航運股也同步走強，顯示台股航運族群的轉強，與國際同業股價表現具有一定連動性。若國際航運股強勢格局延續，台灣相關個股後續仍有表現空間。

news.Title: 獲利了結 日本散戶續減碼日股、賣超額4個月高
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-21 09:11:40 蔡承啟 發佈

外資3週來首度加碼日股，而日本散戶獲利了結，連4週減碼日股，週賣超額創4個月來新高。

綜合日本媒體報導，根據東京證券交易所20日公布的資料顯示，上週(8月第2週、8月10-14日)外資在日本股市(包含東京/名古屋市場)買超2,134億日圓，3週來首度加碼日股。前一週(8月第1週、8月3-7日)外資賣超日股金額為3,827億日圓。

上週日經225指數大漲4.73%(漲3,107點)，而日本散戶獲利了結，上週在日本股市賣超6,557億日圓(前一週為賣超1,566億日圓)，連續第4週減碼日股，週賣超額創4個月來(4月第2週以來)新高水準。

松井證券首席市場分析師窪田朋一郎表示，「7月股市下跌期間逢低買進的散戶，在股價回升後轉而賣股獲利了結」。

另外，上週用來反映年金基金買賣狀況的信託銀行在日本股市賣超823億日圓；用來反映企業庫藏股買回動向的「事業法人」在日本股市買超2,578億日圓，連續第7週加碼日股，週買超額較創歷史新高紀錄的前一週(買超1兆882億日圓)呈現縮小。

news.Title: 台股跌勢擴大下殺300點！航運股逆勢出頭 萬海飆近5％
news.Content:
美股除費城半導體指數全數收黑，主因美國財政部擴大債券回購未能壓低長天期美債殖利率，加上川普政府宣布對伊朗發動史上最嚴厲的經濟制裁，推升國際油價再度飆升，台股今（21）日靠著台積電撐盤上揚，開盤約小跌70點，隨後跌勢擴大下殺300點。

台積電上漲5元至2380元，聯發科回神上漲0.5%，市場傳出Google張量處理器（TPU）除超微參與合作外，邁威爾也搶進供應鏈，市場評估博通與聯發科恐受波及。航運股走強，長榮漲1%，萬海飆近5%，成為資金避風港。

林漢偉分析師表示，由於美債殖利率再度反彈，壓抑全球股市評價，電子權值股普遍進入高檔整理；中小型股近期震盪幅度明顯放大，族群快速輪動，建議操作上不宜追高，重點觀察季線能否守穩，以及主流股拉回後的承接買盤。

林漢偉指出，台股成交量能持續低迷，季線得失成為短線多空關鍵。櫃買指數則受制5日線反壓，觀察記憶體、IC設計與矽光子能否接棒轉強。觀察外資現貨轉為買超73.1億元、期貨空單小幅增加，籌碼面維持中性偏空。

台股昨上漲214點收44,933點，收復季線，但成交量僅8344.1億元，創下三周來新低。

美股道瓊下跌703.84點或1.32%，收52,759.21點。S&P500下跌66.82點或0.87%，收7,641.16點。NASDAQ下跌263.93點或1.00%，收26,067.17點。費城半導體上漲61.79點或0.53%，收11,800.02點。

MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-20 16:44:44 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(20)日強勁反彈，韓國KOSPI指數收於6,852.58點，上漲381.41點或5.89%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於840.89點，上漲16.43點或1.99%。盤面由半導體權值股領軍，外資回流與美國長天期公債殖利率升勢趨緩，成為推升指數重返高檔的主要背景，KOSPI盤中甚至一度觸發「Buy-sidecar」機制。

半導體族群方面，SK Hynix(000660.KS)宣布擬砸約40兆韓元規模買回自家股票並全數註銷，股價收漲12.73%，成為當日最強主線。Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)同步收漲9.49%，SK Square(402340.KS)亦上漲11.85%。電子類股整體走勢明顯擴散，帶動KOSPI指數快速回升。

利率與風險情緒方面，美國財政部擴大10年期至30年期國債回購規模後，長天期殖利率升勢趨緩，緩解了先前壓抑韓股的利率壓力。利率疑慮降溫後，市場風險偏好同步改善，半導體與權值股的上漲幅度因此被放大。

news.Title: 《日股》買盤回流推升 日經收漲1.36%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-20 16:36:19 數位內容中心 發佈

日股今(20)日收高，市場在前一交易日急跌後出現明顯買回，帶動指數回升。日經225指數收於66,216.79點，上漲890.37點或1.36%；東證股價指數(TOPIX)收於4,059.73點，上漲47.42點或1.18%。美股回升與長天期殖利率下滑，為日股開盤後提供支撐，美元兌日圓一度在158日圓附近震盪，匯市雖未明顯轉向，但也未形成新的壓力。

盤面結構上，買盤集中在前一交易日跌幅較大的主力股，成為大盤反彈的主要動能。軟銀集團(9984.JP)、Fast Retailing(9983.JP)、Kioxia Holdings(285A.JP)、Recruit Holdings(6098.JP)、Toyota Motor(7203.JP)、Sony Group(6758.JP)與Honda Motor(7267.JP)走高，帶動指數向上；其中，權值股回穩對日經225指數的拉抬效果尤其明顯。

類股方面，運輸設備、電氣與瓦斯業、醫藥品表現居前，反映資金回流至先前遭到賣壓的族群。Sumitomo Metal Mining(5713.JP)、Daiichi Sankyo(4568.JP)、Nissan Motor(7201.JP)、Sanrio(8136.JP)、東京電力HD(9501.JP)、NEC(6701.JP)與任天堂(7974.JP)等個股同步走強，顯示市場偏向以技術性買回為主，而非全面追價。

相較之下，東京威力科創(8035.JP)、IBIDEN(4062.JP)、SUMCO(3436.JP)、SCREEN Holdings(7735.JP)、Murata Manufacturing(6981.JP)、Lasertec(6920.JP)走弱，壓抑指數上行空間。半導體相關個股的獲利了結持續，成為盤中高檔震盪的主要阻力。

news.Title: 跟進海力士！三星要砸100兆回饋股東 專家笑：過幾天換南亞科？
news.Content:
記憶體族群近期利多消息接連爆發，繼SK海力士宣布砸下40兆韓元（約9156億元新台幣）進行股票回購後，三星電子也傳出準備祭出逾100兆韓元（約2.3兆元新台幣）的股東回報計畫。當沖勒戒所版主葉育碩在 臉書 發文直呼「錢多到滿出來」，並笑稱前有閃迪、昨有海力士、今有三星，甚至喊話「會不會過幾天換南亞科」，市場資金追捧記憶體族群的熱度持續升高。

據 《今日財經》（MoneyToday） 引述業界消息人士報導，三星電子計畫在8月底前召開董事會，審議規模逾100兆韓元的股東回報方案，內容可能包括發放特別現金股息，整體計畫預計主要以自由現金流（FCF）的50%作為資金來源。若最終拍板，將有望創下韓國企業史上規模最大的股東回報計畫。

葉育碩認為，海力士與三星接連祭出大手筆股東回報，背後與AI需求強勁及記憶體價格上漲有關。隨著AI伺服器需求持續成長，記憶體廠獲利及現金流增加，企業手上的現金越來越多，因此選擇透過股票回購或股息把資金回饋給股東。

從利多角度來看，企業願意砸大錢回購自家股票，一方面代表現金水位充裕，另一方面也可視為公司對未來獲利展望具有信心。若股票回購後進一步註銷，流通股數減少，在獲利不變的情況下，理論上也有助於提升每股盈餘（EPS）及每股價值。

不過，葉育碩也提醒，同一項政策其實存在另一種解讀。企業若賺進大量現金，卻沒有把資金全部投入擴產或投資，反而大舉回購股票，市場也可能認為企業覺得現階段擴產效益不高，甚至認為股價遭低估，因此選擇把錢拿回來買股票。

因此，股東回報既可能代表利多「公司現金很多、對未來有信心」，也可能被視為利空「景氣接近高峰，公司開始把錢還給股東」。究竟哪種解讀更接近真相，仍須觀察後續記憶體價格、資本支出及AI需求能否持續。至少短線市場目前已選擇利多解讀，三星百兆韓元股東回報消息，也讓記憶體族群再度成為盤面最受矚目的焦點。

（封面圖／翻攝《Samsung》官網）

news.Title: 外資再度加碼日股；日人狂買海外股票、"破兆"
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-20 13:25:57 蔡承啟 發佈

外資3週來首度加碼日股，而日本投資人(日人)狂買海外股票，週買超額突破1兆日圓大關、創下史上第4高紀錄。

日本財務省20日公佈統計數據指出，上週(8月9-15日)外資在日本股市買超6,212億日圓，為3週來首度加碼日股；2026年迄今(截至8月15日為止)外資買超日股的累計金額擴大至9兆7,659億日圓。

上週外資賣超日本中長期債券金額為1兆2,499億日圓，連續第2週站在賣方；賣超日本短期債券金額為1兆2,075日圓，6週來第5度站在賣方。

總計外資上週流出日本金融市場的資金總額為1兆8,362億日圓，連續第5週呈現淨流出。

上週日本投資人(日人)在海外股市買超1兆3,913億日圓，連續第2週加碼海外股票，週買超額為19週來(3月29日-4月4日當週以來、買超1兆4,343億日圓)首度突破1兆日圓大關、創2005年1月開始進行統計以來史上第4高紀錄；2026年迄今(截至8月15日為止)日人買超海外股票的累計金額擴大至2兆5,299億日圓。

日人上週買超海外中長期債券金額為1兆1,351億日圓，連續第3週站在買方，週買超額連續第2週高於1兆日圓；賣超海外短期債券金額為862億日圓，連續第2週站在賣方。

總計日人上週流入海外金融市場(=流出日本金融市場)的資金總額為2兆4,402億日圓，連續第3週呈現淨流入。

日本觀光相關股走揚。營運機票預約網站的AirTrip早盤大漲2.80%、百貨業者高島屋早盤大漲3.46%、三越伊勢丹早盤漲1.51%。 無懼中國旅客數暴減，7月份訪日外國旅客數4個月來首見增長，其中台灣旅客數首破70萬人、創下單月歷史新高紀錄。

news.Title: 力壓群創、力積電！富喬半小時爆8萬張大量奪成交王 一度亮燈重返百元
news.Content:
玻纖布大廠富喬（1815）今日股價不僅一度衝上漲停板，股價重返百元大關，最高觸及107.5元，更在開盤半小時爆出8萬張大量，力壓群創（3481）、力積電（6770）、華邦電（2344）等一種熱門個股，直衝台股今日成交王寶座。

近期盤面資金鎖定玻纖布與高階PCB材料供應鏈，加上AI伺服器帶動高階玻纖布需求與價格樂觀預期，法人與主動式ETF先前加碼富喬，籌碼有明顯聚集的情況。

今日資金則在早盤大量湧入富喬，一度將股價推升至107.5元漲停價，近日富喬股價站穩周線、月線之上，並支撐在50日均線上方，雖然並未鎖死，不過仍呈現價量齊揚的表現。

成交量能方面，富喬開盤半小時就爆出8萬張以上的量能，力壓群創、力積電、華邦電等一種熱門個股，直衝台股今日成交王寶座，成交金額也超過80億元，表現相當火熱。

news.Title: SK海力士史上最大庫藏股出手！南亞科飆逾8%成台股吸金王 分析師揭1訊號：別追高
news.Content:
南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士昨（19）日宣布祭出史上最大規模庫藏股，今（20）日股價盤中狂飆逾11%，三星電子也大漲近7%，同步帶動台灣記憶體族群走強。台股開盤約半小時，南亞科（2408）大漲逾8%至521元，成交金額達158億元，暫居台股之冠；華邦電（2344）也強漲逾5%。分析師表示，海力士大手筆回購反映市場對未來2至3年記憶體景氣高度信心，但台股近期成交量不足，恐難有連續性上漲，建議等回檔時再進行承接。

觀察記憶體族群，截至上午9時30分，南亞科大漲逾8%至521元，成交量約3.5萬張，成交金額達158億元，高居台股之冠。華邦電也終止連3跌，今反彈上漲逾5%，暫報177.5元，成交量5.8萬張。另外，力積電（6770）、群聯（8299）、旺宏（2337）、晶豪科（3006）也呈現上揚。

華冠投顧分析師陳韋廷表示，海力士執行大規模的庫藏股動作，反映出公司派與市場對未來兩、三年的前景極具信心。此外，近期各家法說會均指出記憶體獲利與毛利率大好，且 AI 伺服器等新興需求持續上修，各家廠商正持續擴產，基本面備受看好。

陳韋廷續指，美光與國際股市前陣子未連續上衝，且華邦電前一日隨大盤拉回並留下跳空缺口，但隨後受到海力士消息激勵，今隨即回補下跌缺口，顯示上升趨勢尚未結束，僅為短線回檔。

然而，近期台股的成交量大致維持在8000億左右，量能相對不足。陳韋廷分析，在大盤量能受限的環境下，大型股或權值股難以出現連續性的上漲，容易進入量縮整理期。因此，在短線操作上，建議盡量利用回檔時再進行承接，避免在量能不足時過度追高。

根據SK海力士向監管機構提交的文件，公司預計自今日至11月19日期間，透過市場交易方式買回最多2,407萬股普通股，完成後將全數註銷。以公司前一交易日收盤價計算，回購規模約40.43兆韓元，這批股份約占總流通股數3.3%。

另外，SK海力士也承諾，2025年至2027年間，至少將50%的自由現金流用於股東回報，包括股票回購、註銷及股利等方式，並預計在公布第三季財報時，進一步揭露完整的股東回報安排。

王詩婷／財經特派記者，主跑勞動部、半導體、生技等
